programme.desc: 調查局機群組群組長方國輝為人精明能乾嫉惡如仇在他對黑道梟雄周朝先的不法行為進行調查時由於周斥巨資賄賂當權人救得庇護令調查一再受挫方國輝在女記者凌飛的鼓勵支援下重拾信心再度採取行動利用黑幫內鬨的機會將周制伏但因事關重大方亦遭撤職吏清則政治清明方國輝堅信正邪不兩立他學民眾的熱烈擁護下決定競選下一屆臺北市長繼續與惡勢力較量

programme.title: 只有我能喜歡妳
programme.desc: 霸氣十足的阿杜，從小就視小他一歲的漂亮小姑姑小琳為心目中的女神，因此在學校中只要誰敢靠近她，他便會想盡各種辦法搞破壞！長大後，在醫院工作的小琳更加美麗動人，她身旁的所有男人更是蠢蠢欲動，讓阿杜決定誓死保衛他的女神，出盡奇招斬斷所有桃花，究竟阿杜能否成功驅逐這些覬覦小琳美色的臭男生，保護好自己的天菜小姑姑呢？

programme.title: 小姐不熙娣:261
programme.desc: 自帶女王氣勢的IPSS 的女王小S，睽違六年強勢回歸！ 以女性出發點的節目議題，聚焦女性的職場與生活感受

programme.title: 全民星攻略:261
programme.desc: 用智慧掌握機會才能創造獨一無二的命運 全民星攻略智慧星幣翻倍賽 不變的是廣度與深度的知識含量

programme.title: 今晚開讚吧:265
programme.desc: 結合不同族群社團粉絲團民調排行榜合作！ 利用大數據分析，反應市場趨勢，精準抓出熱門關注話題！

programme.title: 李茂扮太子
programme.desc: 故事描述富家女楊家珍與小捕快李茂成婚，小兩口平日很恩愛，但李茂的出身不夠高，讓這段婚姻始終得不到楊家珍父母的認可，也總讓他們爭執不斷李茂用盡各種方式想獲得升遷，得到岳家認同，讓老婆過上好日子一次意外，他發現自己竟然與當朝太子的相貌相同，一個想進宮獲得晉升，一個想出宮獲得自由，兩人一拍即合，同意交換身份，這一換，攪得楊家和皇宮中都雞飛狗跳，卻不知兩人正一步步捲入尚書大人的陰謀裡...

programme.title: 一秒拳王
programme.desc: 周天仁終日在酒吧渾噩，兒子對他毫不尊敬，?了躲避債主，天仁運用一秒預知超能力成功逃脫，意外被屢戰屢敗的拳擊教練阿信發現，拉攏他合作挑戰秒殺拳王Joe，堂妹小瑤多番阻撓也無補於事一秒雖然很短，卻能創出宇宙；從未認真看待自己的天仁，決定藉此難得機會，運用這個超能力，在擂臺上尋回失落已久的人生初衷，?了自己，?了兒子，好好活一次！其實輸怎會一世，贏又真的只在一秒？

programme.title: 飛砂風中轉
programme.desc: 兩個前黑幫成員被推舉出來角逐黑社會龍頭，但兩人其實都想回歸正常生活，看來一定得智取對方才能穩輸不贏

programme.title: 使徒行者
programme.desc: 女臥底阿釘（佘詩曼飾）收到一個以摩斯密碼打出的神秘訊息，一個自稱Blackjack的臥底表示跟警隊失聯，阿釘隨即報告上司Q Sir（吳鎮宇飾），一輪尋找臥底行動立即展開過程裡，阿釘被引到賭場，竟發現當年被槍殺的覃歡喜（許紹雄飾）死而復生

programme.title: 葉問前傳
programme.desc: 講述葉問年輕時的求學經過，且將重點擺在葉問年輕時代的愛情故事，以及對於國族的深厚情感

programme.title: 西遊記之月光寶盒
programme.desc: 菩提老祖為了挽回自己的過失阻止兩人陰謀來到五嶽山，他說明至尊寶是孫悟空轉世，至尊寶不相信白骨精五百年前和孫悟空有一段糾纏不清的戀情，此時為了救至尊寶襲擊春三十娘，卻中毒受傷此時牛魔王殺到，二女不敵，挾持至尊寶和二當家逃回到盤絲洞春三十娘逼迫白晶晶殺掉至尊寶，卻反被二人關在機關春欲用迷情大法對付至尊寶，又錯用在二當家身上

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大，某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻不派齊君元追查，他決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗中調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元更發現自己身陷一個局，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人是何許人也？

programme.title: 長歌行:2
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 麻雀王
programme.desc: 20多年前，阿發（杜汶澤 飾） 和阿順（李國煌 飾） 都是麻將天尊儒五常（曾志偉 飾）的徒弟但如今阿發在怡保老街角落一間殘舊咖啡店賣釀豆腐，這間小店生意不算很好，但也過得去，最主要是這裡有一 群幾十年的老顧客，因此生意無憂阿發的妻子雷夢娜（葉璇 飾） 多年前已經出走，丟下他獨自撫養女兒四喜，如今四喜已是個花樣年華的少女

programme.title: 寒單
programme.desc: 正月十五，夜晚的街頭鑼鼓喧天，炮炸寒單爺現場擠滿了人潮，肉身寒單阿義站在神轎上，威風凜凜地接受信徒丟上鞭炮轟炸忽然間，成堆的炸藥被引爆，震耳欲聾，尖叫聲不斷...... 意外造成阿義女友萱萱的死亡，不忍心看保住性命卻喪失一切的阿義墮落社會邊緣，正昆毅然放棄成為教師的機會挺身相助，用盡力氣將阿義拉離地獄的深淵歃血為盟的兄弟二人，一同經營昆儀回收場刻苦耐勞地生活著，卻怎知當年意外的真相曝光之後，從此兩人在情義的天平兩端生死掙扎，炸在身上的紋身之罪，是否能抵消深藏的錐心之痛？

programme.title: 賭神
programme.desc: 賭神高進受日本山口組的上山委託來港與殺父仇人賭魔鮑漢林決戰進看出主事人南哥等人出千，出手反千贏回大量巨款而去南哥不憤指使越南殺手追殺進上山先生委派龍五保護進火拼中，進頭部受重傷不支倒地記憶全失，被刀仔及其女友收留賭摩之助手南哥得知進等藏身於銷魂別墅即派數拾殺手追殺，追殺期間進漸回復記憶，再和賭摩在牌上決戰一場

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: 1969年夏天，高姓紗廠老闆因敗賭而致家破人亡，他的八歲兒子高進從此喪失家園輾轉之下，高進加入老千集團拜靳能（鍾景輝飾）為師，與高傲（吳鎮宇飾）成同門，跟靳能學習一切千門技術到了1986年，二十五歲的高進（黎明飾）已成為獨當一面的老千高手，並和靳能的女兒靳輕（梁詠琪飾）情投意合

programme.title: 佛跳牆
programme.desc: 李翰祥執導的佛跳牆共有四個單元，首個故事是描述一對母子因施予濟公一碗豆漿而逃過喪命之危；其二則說濟公幫助賣菜漢，逃離高利貸者的滋擾；其三則寫濟公以櫻桃化夜明珠，將大盜教訓一頓；最末一則是描寫濟公以巧計捉弄胡作非為的相爺父子李翰祥借濟公的善行，針貶權貴惡霸的種種惡行，為平民大眾吐一口烏氣

programme.desc: 明朝後期，內憂外患，東有倭寇侵擾，西有異族覬覦沉迷于煉丹修道的老皇上迫於百官壓力，決定立皇長子賢王為太子，並宣召賢王的岳父鎮守西北的老英王前來參加冊立大典這引起強烈渴求儲君之位的皇四子敬王及其政治盟友東廠大太監曹少欽的不滿，暗中策劃陰謀...

programme.title: 賭俠1999
programme.desc: King（劉德華 飾）頭腦靈活，機智過人，憑著其銳利的眼光十足的把握在賭場叱吒一時無人能及，被譽為賭神接班人 在一次赴會，其弟Jack不幸被兇悍的殺手煙通（吳毅將 飾）所殺，KING重傷之餘亦意外錯殺煙通，被警方判以誤殺罪名監禁五年大著肚子的妻子與拍檔虫（張錦程飾）捨他而去在KING出獄後追尋許久也不曾發現兩人下落 化骨龍（張家輝 飾）終日無所事事，人生哲學是人生如賭博有賭未為輸，視King為偶像，希望能學一招半式的賭博技倆，二人亦成為知交，交心的好拍檔晴（朱茵 飾），化骨龍的親妹，爽朗可愛善解人意，愛情上波折重重常被俊男所騙，自King與龍踢爆其男友職業是鴨，並安排難忘的盛大生日會，晴開始對King大生好感

programme.title: 千王
programme.desc: 在千王的世界裡，知人知面不知心，愈是靦腆有禮，愈要小心提防千術高手黃上千擊敗台灣泰斗，二人結下仇怨由於一場騙局，黃與星洲富婆惺惺相識，並決定合謀為民徐害，以美人局騙去貴利龍二百萬，不料貴利龍請來高手要扳回一城.....

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道長所在的村落中有一座殘舊的教堂，修女瑪利亞前往重開教堂，剛巧村裡無水可用，村長找一眉道長勘察地理來尋找問題的源頭，發現是村中突然多出大量蝙蝠，並棲身於此教堂裡

programme.title: 鍾馗誅妖傳
programme.desc: 唐朝時期妖怪肆虐，天神因而封印妖王沐風的妖力，使其無法作亂妖王的伴侶，千年花妖風四娘，為了解除封印，便到處尋找捉妖天師鍾馗的下落面對強妖來襲，鍾馗為了保護百姓，想出一招險記來對付風四娘

programme.title: 神鬼高校
programme.desc: 看似平凡的高中校園裡，有一個惡名昭彰的四年九班，裡面盡是一些三年內畢不了業的問題學生，其中又以綽號為大麻陽偉麥基和香香這三男一女為首，到處惹麻煩，以捉弄老師欺負同學破壞校園秩序，是校園裡最叫人頭痛的四個學生一次意外中，不慎炸傷了班導師顏惜嬌，惜嬌情商男朋友甄健代課學生們摩拳擦掌準備要好好對付新來的代課老師，殊不知這次來的可是個不好惹的狠角色

programme.title: 我的老婆是老大3-韓語
programme.desc: 阿玲是香港最強的黑道組織頭目林會長的女兒，由於組織間的勢力衝突，林會長不得不送阿玲去韓國東方派楊會長的地盤上暫避風頭，而楊會長對此事也甚為重視，特意派出組織裏的3號人物基哲負責保護阿玲的安全然而無巧不成書的是基哲一行人並不知道阿玲的真正身份把阿玲當成了觀光的遊客無比傲慢，而身份大揭開後則是無比驚恐 中國話講的半通不通的基哲緊急招聘延邊女孩延熙作翻譯，而延熙夾在這兩個劍撥弩張火氣沖天中的黑道人物之間，誰也不敢得罪，只能憑主觀翻譯，笑料百出可是一直要取阿玲性命甚至跨國追蹤的殺手們的到來使阿玲的性命危在旦夕，而她身邊的所有人也被牽連

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 消失於中國歷史的10大暗器之首，清朝血滴子暗殺部隊，唯一終極任務就是取下你的人頭！ 反清復明組織牧人日漸強大，以天狼為其首領的 黃曉明飾嚴重威脅清朝盛世，清朝雍正皇帝與兒子乾隆為剷除此勢力，為此培養以血滴子為兵器的特種暗殺部隊從小即接受專業訓練的部隊精英，擅長操作從未有人見其樣貌的神祕飛天暗器血滴子，此兵器能來無影去無蹤的取人首級而瞬間致死，被殺者往往連自己怎麼死的都不曉得血滴子隊長冷（阮經天飾）奉朝廷之命率領率領陳泰蒲巴甲飾 胡圖高天飾穆森李宇春飾十三井柏然飾布喀周一圍飾阿蘇郭鵬飾共7名高手，執行朝廷反清異己的秘密任務，眼看殺人於無形的血滴子天團即將面對史上最強宿敵，從未失手的他們，卻料想不到陷入腹背受敵的陰謀之中，因而從此改寫清朝的命運

programme.title: 千王
programme.desc: 在千王的世界裡，知人知面不知心，愈是靦腆有禮，愈要小心提防千術高手黃上千擊敗台灣泰斗，二人結下仇怨由於一場騙局，黃與星洲富婆惺惺相識，並決定合謀為民徐害，以美人局騙去貴利龍二百萬，不料貴利龍請來高手要扳回一城.....

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: 德華（劉德華飾）天生喜愛打牌，以打牌維生，牌技和牌品俱佳，足跡踏遍各大小屋?，人稱麻將大俠詠琪（梁詠琪飾）是德華的舊女友，因牌品差遭德華狠撇，卻對德華戀戀不捨，常以不同的身份和形象出現糾纏著德華，令德華不勝其煩 另一方面，德華多年前因打麻將以致債台高築連累家庭，弟弟天樂（古天樂飾）因此仇視德華而且極度憎恨麻將，自此與母親（黃文慧飾）相依為命而且兄弟老死不相往來天樂憑一己實力圖強讀書希望為母親帶來安穩生活，可惜在經濟不景氣下失業且變成負資產，母親更患上了阿茲海默症，德華以打麻將替母醫病之餘，決重新擔起這頭家 一回，天樂被青雲（劉青雲飾）一伙人詐騙輸光，德華為弟弟出頭找青雲出氣，後來青雲牌技不如德華大敗，青雲欲拜德華為師但被拒時詠琪隆胸後又再出現找德華，但再次被拒愛，悲憤之下詛咒德華一世摸爛牌另一方面，青雲卻看中詠琪，對詠琪展開追求，詠琪為刺激德華而

programme.desc: 明朝後期，內憂外患，東有倭寇侵擾，西有異族覬覦沉迷于煉丹修道的老皇上迫於百官壓力，決定立皇長子賢王為太子，並宣召賢王的岳父鎮守西北的老英王前來參加冊立大典這引起強烈渴求儲君之位的皇四子敬王及其政治盟友東廠大太監曹少欽的不滿，暗中策劃陰謀...

programme.title: 台語報萬事

programme.title: 天天天晴:7
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.title: 踩過界2:17
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 東坡家事:30
programme.desc: 一代大文豪蘇東坡（歐陽震華飾），才華洋溢，生性豁達，對亡妻王弗情深義重這份深情，讓寄居於蘇府的王弗堂妹王閏之（萬綺雯飾）對東坡暗生情愫，並多番暗示，惜東坡一直迴避其心意一次，東坡和閏之意外惹怒壽安郡主（李亞男飾），閏之為保東坡仕途，答應郡主下嫁鼓莊公子韓元不知情的東坡以為閏之終於想通，送她出嫁，豈料卻發現韓家暗地裡經營假官交子（偽鈔）勾當，韓太君脅持蘇家眾人，逼閏之跟韓元成親，幸關鍵時刻得秦少游（王浩信飾）相救，少游卻失蹤

programme.title: 翻生武林:3
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 棟仁的時光:15
programme.desc: 一個吻可以改寫甚麼？一個媽媽的吻別，令閏秒出生就夭折的曾棟仁奇蹟地活下來一個急救之吻，救護員程敏琦令棟仁得以續命，讓他知道自己有偷時間續命的能力，也讓敏琦昏睡兩日，錯過了自己的婚禮，未婚夫還離奇失蹤！一個借來的吻，同時感應到對方的想法或感受，令棟仁攀上事業高峰，並足以協助身邊人改寫命運：改善單親爸爸張潮岸的父女關係激發廢青羅瑞楠的鬥志一個最後續命之吻，也是愛人敏琦奪命之吻，棟仁會如何抉擇？

programme.title: 舞動全城:1
programme.desc: 醉心舞蹈的李心盈廖碧兒一心投考香港舞蹈團，卻在考試前在超市遇上哥哥李力強黎耀祥和同事程嘉俊馬浚偉，盈不慎被俊的手推車絆倒，令盈在選拔試中失準，錯失機會

programme.title: 踩過界2:18
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 棟仁的時光:16
programme.desc: 一個吻可以改寫甚麼？一個媽媽的吻別，令閏秒出生就夭折的曾棟仁奇蹟地活下來一個急救之吻，救護員程敏琦令棟仁得以續命，讓他知道自己有偷時間續命的能力，也讓敏琦昏睡兩日，錯過了自己的婚禮，未婚夫還離奇失蹤！一個借來的吻，同時感應到對方的想法或感受，令棟仁攀上事業高峰，並足以協助身邊人改寫命運：改善單親爸爸張潮岸的父女關係激發廢青羅瑞楠的鬥志一個最後續命之吻，也是愛人敏琦奪命之吻，棟仁會如何抉擇？

programme.title: 迷網:22
programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 翻生武林:4
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.desc: Daring Sung Dynasty must fight their way out of trap after trap and band together to save the prime minister. (勇士朝必须在陷后扎起来,共同拯救总理.)

programme.title: Killers on Wheels ((无法无天飞车党))
programme.desc: While taking a ferry on the way to a vacation, Kwok and his family meet a road thug who puts an ugly spin on their holiday plans. (随着乘坐渡轮前往度假的路上,)

programme.title: Gang Master ((帮规))
programme.desc: As a young clan member rises to helm the Dragon gang after his foster fathers death, an incriminating letter changes everything. Can he fight the tide? (作为一个年轻的部落成员, 后继父去世后, 起身领导龙团队, 一封指责的信改变一切.)

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers ((蔡李佛小子))
programme.desc: Alexander Fu stars as a young carriage driver who finds love and encounters peril after he rescues a girl from being harassed by a dangerous group. (亚历山大·福饰演一位年轻的车手,他发现爱情,)

programme.title: Sunset ((落日))
programme.desc: What starts off as a musical romp turns into something more akin to a Shakespearean tragedy than a beach-babe party. Starring Ching Li. (开始的音乐剧变成了比海婴儿派对更像莎士比亚悲剧.)

programme.title: Disciples of Shaolin ((洪拳小子))
programme.desc: One of Chang Chehs finest films, this saga stars Alexander Fu Sheng in his greatest martial arts role as a penniless country boy who fights his way to riches. (这部电影是长最好的电影之一, 亚历山大·福·申饰演了他最伟大的武术角色,)

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate ((舞衣))
programme.desc: Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women expect of it. (元将星星结合在一起,创造了一个关于香港社会的不同观点的杰作.)

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle ((神鵰英雄))
programme.desc: This martial arts drama centres on the Thirteen Eagles Assassination Sect of the infamous Iron Boat Clan. Starring Ti Lung, Fu Sheng. (这部武术剧围绕着臭名昭著的铁船族的13个杀宗派.)

programme.title: Love Without End 1970 ((不了情 1970))
programme.desc: This shot-in-colour remake of the classic black-and-white drama has Jenny Hu in the tragic role made famous by Linda Lin Dai.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat (猫 VS 鼠)
programme.desc: After the emperors seal is stolen, The Rat and The Cats squabble for martial arts supremacy is put on hold for a time. (皇帝的章被盗后, 鼠和猫争夺武术优势,)

programme.title: Mr Funny Bone ((老夫子))
programme.desc: Whenever Mr. Funny Bone travels about with his sidekick Big Potato, he often gets involved in all manner of charming comic mishaps. (哥先生和他的助手大一起旅行时,他经常卷入各种迷人的漫画意外.)

programme.title: Killer Clans ((流星蝴蝶剑))
programme.desc: This abourer and complex adaptation of a popular wuxia novel contains conspiracies, stratagems, and sword fights aplenty. (这部流行的武士小说的繁而复杂改编包含了阴谋,策略和剑斗争.)

programme.title: Woman of the Night ((蛇变惊魂夜))
programme.desc: This three-film anthology collectively offers up a captivating examination of human obsession and love. (这三部电影集集集,总结了人类的痴迷和爱情.)

programme.title: Temple of the Red Lotus ((江湖奇侠))
programme.desc: When the family that a man named Wu Jimmy Wang Yu marries into comes under repeated attack, he suspects that his in-laws are bandits. (当一个名叫武吉米王尤的家人被反复攻击时,他怀疑他的岳父是强盗.)

programme.title: The Sword of Swords ((剑来))
programme.desc: After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the mans fiance. (一个师父把他的魔术武器交给了他的顶级学生后,一个嫉妒的对手走了去绑架男人的未婚夫.)

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes (许多香水的土地)
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man. (子,子,修道士沙子和猪发现自己处于一个领域,)

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby ((红孩儿))
programme.desc: Go on a quest with the Monkey King, Goddess of Mercy and Dragon Girl, as they battle Hung, the son of the Ox Demon to save Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim. (随着子王,慈悲女神和龙女神一起去探险,他们与雄牛恶魔的儿子洪战斗,)

programme.title: Love Without End 1961 ((不了情 1961))
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan, capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat ((罗小黑战记))
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue. (导演Chor Yuen与小说家,古龙和超级明星,蒂隆,在这个令人兴奋的后续剧中重新相遇.)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1961
programme.desc: With a focus on the pampered teenaged Jia Bao Yu, believed to be of supernatural origins, this Chinese classic depicts the Jia familys rise and fall.

programme.title: The Killer ((杀手锏))
programme.desc: Starring Chin Han, Wang Ping and Tsung Hua, this movie revolves around the challenges that beset three sworn brothers and sisters. (电影中主演的是汉,王平和华.)

programme.title: Tales of Larceny ((牛鬼蛇神))
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear! (那些有精力挑选的钱包手,)

programme.title: Clan of the White Lotus ((洪文定三破白莲教))
programme.desc: A hero Gordon Liu Chia hui must learn Embroidery Fist and acupuncture to counter a villains Lo Lieh deadly fight techniques. (一个英雄戈登··奇亚·胡必须学习刺拳和针,以抵制恶棍洛·莱赫的致命战斗技巧.)

programme.title: The Snake Prince ((蛇王子))
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy. (由于三位部落妇女的情感舞蹈吸引了三位蛇兄弟,)

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon ((8块钱富豪))
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse? (当一个苦扎的画家收到一个无休止地产生RM8笔钱包时,他的生活从困难转变为奢品.)

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins ((十月围城))
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty. (获8项HKFA奖,其中包括全明星演员,这部电影描绘了一支精英团队在香港守卫孙森博士,)

programme.title: Cesium Fallout ((焚城))
programme.desc: Hong Kongs survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city? (由于辐射泄漏,香港的生存处于危险之中.消防队被分配到进入辐射区以阻止产量.面对这种前所未有的灾难,他们能拯救城市吗?)

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900 ((唐探1900))
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger. (在20世纪20年代旧金山,在中国街区谋杀一名白人妇女引起了公众的愤怒.)

programme.title: Its a Wonderful Life ((好运到))
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his sons failed marriage and Kwais dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto. (泰,一个富人不满意他的儿子失败的婚姻,克瓦伊梦想成为漫画家.他希望他的女儿,安,但她从法国返回与野蛮的鲁伯托.)

programme.title: Inexternal ((天地拳王))
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Mings mother finds a way to save her son. (陷入昏迷状态,被运往一个幻想世界,老老师教他以战胜一个邪恶老板的古老拳击技巧.)

programme.title: Love Punch ((私恋失调))
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream? (阳失去了奥运会梦想,退出拳击.十年后,李教练帮助她复出.)

programme.title: CJ7 ((长江7号：超萌特攻队))
programme.desc: When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money cant buy. (当一个穷人从垃圾箱里拿出一个玩具给儿子的时候,)

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon ((但愿人长久))
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty and their fathers drug addiction. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones. (和她的妹妹面临身份危机,贫困和他们的父亲的毒品成.)

programme.title: WE 12 ((一夜夫妻120蚊))
programme.desc: 12 elite members of an underground organization who possess extraordinary skills need to revive their team spirit and reunite to save the world from disaster. (秘密组织的12名精英成员,拥有非凡的技能,需要重新振兴他们的团队精神,)

programme.title: Hell Hole ((地狱洞))
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era, revolving around a pregnant woman, a bullied boy who committed suicide, and some company staff who open a box of used clothes.

programme.title: Mamas Affair ((巨星养成记))
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: High Forces ((危机航线))
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis? (乘客们在首次飞行时,一架A380航班被枪手劫持.其中一名安全专家,他的女儿是被俘的.)

programme.title: Lost Love ((夕笛))
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young sons death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship? (梅试图通过成为抚养父母来克服她的小儿子的死亡.她对孩子的奉献使她忽视她的丈夫.)

programme.title: Wu Kong ((悟空传))
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family ((奸人世家))
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart. (一个8年前在一个灾难性的冬日变节晚餐中被撕裂的家庭,)

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story ((阖家辣))
programme.desc: Coba turns his mothers chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity. (科巴在整个家庭的帮助下,在疫情期间,把他的母亲的汁变成了流行商品.)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple ((我来自纽约))
programme.desc: This heartwarming box office smash captures how a little Chinese girl, raised in New York, begins to discover her roots when she visits Malaysia.

programme.title: Ne Zha 2 ((哪吒之魔童闹海))
programme.desc: After a catastrophe, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing are saved, but their bodies will soon dissipate. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them with the Seven-Coloured Lotus, hoping to change their destiny. (师试图用七色莲花恢复他们,希望改变他们的命运.)

programme.title: Crypto Storm ((反贪风暴之加密危机))
programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a banks top executives use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market. (国际货币监管局官员洛克成立了一个专门团队调查涉及银行高管使用加密货币来操纵交易市场的腐败案件.)

programme.title: Everything Under Control ((超神经械劫案下))
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences. (在钻石抢劫期间,杰利偷走了物品,他和其他队友们在他的脚上.)

programme.title: Remarkable Construction Ep06 ((大国建造 Ep06))
programme.desc: Documentaries in this slot are rebroadcasts of our most-viewed and most popular stories of the season. They feature important social, economic, environmental affecting lives nationwide. (据此,该片中的纪录片是我们本季最受欢迎的故事的重播.)

programme.title: Cultural Inheritors Ep05
programme.desc: Documentaries in this slot are rebroadcasts of our most-viewed and most popular stories of the season. They feature important social, economic, environmental affecting lives nationwide. (据此,该片中的纪录片是我们本季最受欢迎的故事的重播.)

programme.title: Fall in Love With Museums Ep01
programme.desc: A strand devoted to the nature and wildlife of China, the people who lived alongside them, and the great and diverse landscapes with which they all contend. (专注于中国的自然和野生动物,)

programme.title: Wisdoms Breath: the Living Tradition of Chinese Medicine Ep02
programme.desc: Real life stories told from the personal perspective. Moving, dramatic, sorrows and joys, expressed emphatically and expressed quietly. Watch closely to see and understand the real China as it is lived. (故事讲述了真实的生活,从个人角度讲述. 动作,戏剧性,悲伤和喜悦,强调和静地表达.)

programme.title: Beijing Daxing International Airport Ep01 ((Beijing Da双星报喜 International Airport Ep01))
programme.desc: Prestige Chinese documentary production, tackling serious subjects with the best cinematography, editing, and all round production values with a unique Chinese perspective. (位中国纪录片制作,以最好的影视,编辑和具有独特的中国视角的全面生产价值来解决严的主题.)

programme.title: The Engraved Blade Ep01 ((The Engraved 命运之夜 无限剑制 Ep01))
programme.desc: A documentary series showcasing the history of China and its people. (展示中国及其人民的历史.)

programme.title: Enduring Legacy: Historical and Cultural Cities Ep19
programme.desc: A documentary series featuring historical and archaeological exploration. (一部纪录片系列,涉及历史和考古探索.)

programme.title: Flavors of China: Exploring Tastes Chinas Food Culture Ep01 ((去“湘”当有味的地方 China: Exploring Tastes Chinas Food Culture Ep01))
programme.desc: Food connects people! A feast for the eyes that spotlights the cuisines of China in a way thats bound to set the mouths of the whole globe watering! (食物连接着人们! 一个眼睛盛宴,以一种方式突出中国的美食,)

programme.title: New Frontiers in Chinese Sci-Fi Ep04 (科幻小说中新界限 Ep04)
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: Tales in Light and Shadow
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form. (精心制作的短片纪录片,讲述了中国各个方面的故事!)

programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Veg-O-Vision Song Contest
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Peas earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his fathers death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiance enlists a swordsmanwho secretly loves herto search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end u

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the speed gang, led by Johnny, and Kuos sister Carrie is molested by Johnnys brother Michael. Kuos family continues to be harassed by the speed gang while on the island can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the Tsai Li Fu style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qis guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King Liu Chung-chun teams up with Goddess of Mercy Chao Li-chuan and the Dragon Girl Lung Nu to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh Ting Hua-chung,son of the Ox Demon Hung Hai-erh to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim Teng Chio-jen.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tiens gang is helping them he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Los brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hus house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hus pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Gao Xing De Suan Tian Ku La
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has posttraumatic stress disorder after his wifes death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firms VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the teams downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandoras box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandoras Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witchbut can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Ip Man

超级夜总会 Super Nightclub
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的超级夜总会，佳乐台抢先火速送上.

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 Top Singers
programme.desc: 难得一见以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！超级红人榜的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！.

programme.title: 温暖的甜蜜的 Warm And Sweet
programme.desc: 南飞和家宜这对好友都面临婚姻的考题：南飞的恋人陈放对婚姻犹豫不决而未能离开前妻；家宜在结婚前夕突然明白婚姻应该为爱情而非安全感南飞于是放下工作与陈放，到贫困地区帮助弱势的一群找回自信家宜与焦岳在携手进行房屋改造中产生微妙的感情千回百转，南飞与陈放家宜与焦岳，终于看清了自己的内心，收获婚姻与爱情，领悟了美好生活的真谛.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 Memorable Classic Songs
programme.desc: 全新音乐节目那些年那些歌由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老中青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温6070年代的美好时光rnrnMemorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo.

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第一季 Earthly Ambrosia S1
programme.desc: 大地餐桌走访西南乡野，探寻当地饮食文化，以人物故事串连食材菜肴与本土的饮食习惯，展现当地滋味与食物有关的情感故事The series traverses the countryside of southwest China in exploration of the local food culture, connecting the local produce with dishes through personal stories, showcasing the local flavors.

programme.title: 卧底娇娃 Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 百味人生 Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 型男大主厨 Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的.

programme.desc: 梁芷佩重启南美洲之行，解锁更多拉丁国家，一趟旅程玩转四季！漫步阿根廷世遗冰川，一尝加入冰川冰块的威士忌发掘Patagonia的世外桃源，享受美景与美食转往智利复活节岛，藉单车环岛游找寻巨型石像亚马逊森林是世界最大的热带雨林，跟随原住民开展探险之旅位于厄瓜多尔的加拉帕戈斯群岛因进化论而闻名，登岛一探动物生态来到哥伦比亚，爽浸泥浆浴，再于加勒比海畅泳，顺道到访海中心的悬浮小岛，见识岛民生活.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 溏心风暴3 Heart And Greed
programme.desc: 凌丽荧李司棋与丈夫黄永正夏雨凭着努力从茶餐厅发展成为结合地产业务的集团，丽荧弟弟凌乘风黄宗泽更协助他们上市，永正本不欲上市，但因当年许雅麟李国麟助他脱罪之恩，一直耿耿于怀，有见许家经营印刷的百年基业面临倒闭危机，便听从乘风献计，可透过合并令两家相得益彰，但永正的弟妇梁顺华关菊英及亲弟梁赞阮兆祥大力反对，加上与雅麟的太太余秀慧米雪有积怨，对许家自诩上等人印象欠佳，但丽荧力撑丈夫终达成合并协议可惜合并后引发两家一连串的祸端，草根与富豪阶级悬殊激发矛盾丛生，加上二儿子黄围家王浩信与许家独生女许贝儿岑丽香相爱备受阻挠，最终逼使围家远离伤心地，丽荧心痛不已又承受长女黄以爱陈敏之与有妇之夫郑立安唐文龙的丑闻煎熬；就连至疼锡的乘风亦性情大变，与好友方希文黄翠如关系纠缠不清，两家陷入分拆决裂之余更面临一场酝酿已久的复仇风暴.

programme.title: 赤沙印记 四叶草.2 Sunshine Heartbeat
programme.desc: 沙滩上，少年十五二十时；他们抛汗， 他们随入情网叶菁杨婉仪叶蕙李思欣及叶茵陈自琦三姊妹小时侯 碰到一个古上贼女郎部容衢儿，女郎预言大家姐将在十八岁那年，遇见身上有四叶草胎记的真命天子转眼间三姊妹已长大，现在是清岚国际学校的中六生清岚沙滩排球队的队长干逸臣司徒瑞祈外表俊朗性格活泼，是校内的风头人物，很多女同学也为了他而加入沙滩排球队，犹如行星屋绕太阳一般一日，三姊妹分别在不同的角度看见臣身上有一个近似四叶草形状的胎记，跟小时侯听到的预言吻合，但菁为人优柔寡断没有主见，菁与茵因因此抛身而出，为制造机会给姐姐而不断奔走不久，三姊妹亦加入了沙滩排球队她们觉得的是，她们竟又在校内的垒学士方上发现四叶草胎记！三姊妹顿感迷闷，不知道吉卜赛女郎所言的真命天子究竟是谁.

programme.title: 食为奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天宝王祖蓝自小吃尽珍馐百味，各种美食经他一尝便知龙与凤，但遭逢家道中落被迫与家仆李卫胡诺言流落街头，以卖饱糊口，因美食令他结识了卖艺女子纪慕雪万绮雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女厨神米小鱼何雁诗等人，更因缘际会遇上微服出游的四皇子胤禛黄智贤，二人气味相投，被引进到宫内的御膳房当御厨，天宝遇上宿敌蔡鹤亭林盛斌，掀起连场龙争虎斗；但天宝万料不到自己竟卷入由八皇子胤禩张继聪策动的夺嫡之争中，在劣势下天宝成了胤禛的福将，连番替他反败为胜，但一段意外的婚约却令天宝由一人之下顿贬为丧家狗.

programme.title: 坚离地爱坚离地 Offliners, The
programme.desc: 在香港，投身金融地产商业是贴地举动，富二代王子菲龚嘉欣饰却偏爱离地，与好友许正伟陈智燊饰开设初创科技公司一次网络黑客事件让子菲见识到IT奇才丁信希张振朗饰的厉害，邀他加入公司信希是一名离地毒男，不顾世事，得护士张莱刘佩玥饰帮助走出不善沟通的围墙，对她好感渐生；子菲与信希经历分歧，至同心及互补不足，不经意对他产生情愫子菲本相信科技为世界带来美好，但网络风波相继发生在其父王守勤李国麟饰弟王梓龙罗梓龙饰信希之妹丁信恩黄心颖饰身上！.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Si Luncai
programme.desc: Cinta ditolak kerana pangkat dan darjat, Si Luncai, sang pengembala kambing pergi dengan harapan yang hancur. Dirinya yang lurus dipermainkan oleh Ketua Kampung - namun kejadian tersebut telah membawanya ke seorang nenek kebayan yang telah mengubah hidupnya. Si Luncai menyamar menjadi tukang tabib dan mempermainkan semula Ketua Kampung itu. Berjayakah rancangan Si Luncai untuk mendapatkan cintanya?

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. Walau perasaan cinta masih kuat, hubungan mereka tidak dapat diteruskan kerana Akhbar sudah pun berkahwin. Suratan takdir mengatakan sebaliknya apabila Auzy kini mengajar anak kepada Akhbar, Andy.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Percintaan yang ditentang keluarga kerana perbezaan darjat membuatkan Ayu dan Taufiq terpaksa membawa haluan berbeza. Ayu, penyanyi di kelab malam jatuh cinta dengan Taufiq, pengurus syarikat insuran yang berasal dari keluarga kaya. Ditentang oleh ibu Taufiq, mereka merasakan restu keluarga amat penting dan terpaksa membuat keputusan penting untuk masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai pintu menuju surga selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

Sambil menambah pengalaman berniaga, Azzam juga berdepan konflik cinta apabila wanita yang dicintainya telah dipinang sahabatnya, sementara Eliana yang menyukainya sendiri belum dapat diterimanya sebagai pilihan hati.

Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Cikgu Lutfi yang baru ditukarkan ke sekolah berusaha membantu Hadi dan adiknya yang kematian ibu, tetapi konflik timbul apabila ibu saudara mereka kembali dan menimbulkan masalah keluarga

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Mega Series Suara Hati Istri: Anjani
programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
programme.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

programme.title: Broken Heart Terhebat
programme.desc: Khanza Shanice Margaretha dan Arkhan El Ryan saling menyimpan perasaan, namun memilih memendamnya demi menjaga persahabatan mereka. Khanza mengutamakan tanggungjawab terhadap keluarganya sehingga mengetepikan soal cinta, manakala Arkhan pula takut kehilangan Khanza jika meluahkan isi hatinya.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Foodie Buddy
programme.desc: Program masakan dan kulinari yang meneroka keunikan serta kekayaan cita rasa hidangan Indonesia, menampilkan pelbagai sajian tradisional, ramuan tempatan dan pengalaman kulinari dari seluruh negara.

programme.title: Rindu Bukan Rindu
programme.desc: Rindu Bukan Rindu mengisahkan kisah seorang wanita bernama Rindu yang merasa bertuah memiliki seorang lelaki bernama Devan. Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. Tetapi suatu hari, Rindu melihat Devan memegang tangan seorang wanita lain. Apakah yang terjadi di antara mereka?

programme.title: DAcademy 7

Peserta dari seluruh negara bertanding dengan menyanyikan lagu dangdut, menunjukkan bakat vokal dan persembahan mereka. Sepanjang musim, mereka dinilai oleh juri profesional dan undian penonton. Siapakah yang akan menjuarai DAcademy musim ketujuh?

programme.title: Hi Guys
programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. Mereka meneroka pelbagai tempat menarik dan aktiviti yang mengujakan, sambil berkongsi pengalaman dengan semangat ingin tahu dan keceriaan. Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Bulan Terbelah di Hati Mas Silver
programme.desc: Fikri, seorang lelaki tampan dan sederhana yang sedang mencari pekerjaan. Suatu hari, dia ditawarkan oleh rakannya untuk berkerja sebagai manusia silver. Walaupun pada awalnya, dia ragu, Fikri akhirnya menerima tawaran tersebut kerana memerlukan duit. Namun, pada waktu pertama kali bekerja, Fikri telah tertangkap dan berkenalan dengan Bulan, seorang komandan Satpoll PP yang cantik namun tegas. Meskipun pekerjaan mereka sangat berbeza, benih cinta mulai tumbuh antara mereka.

programme.title: HI-FIVE
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: CITIZEN OF A KIND ((市民德熙))
programme.desc: Duk-hee receives a call from a bank offering a loan. After sending money for fees, she realizes that was a scam. She receives another call one day. This time, its a plea for help... (杜克希收到了一个银行提供的信贷的电话. 之后,她发现这是一个骗局. 有一天,她又收到一个电话. 这一次,这是一个请求帮助的.)

programme.title: ORDINARY PERSON ((凡人的品格))
programme.desc: Sung-jin is a police officer involved in a conspiracy after he arrested a suspected murderer by chance. Gyu-nam exploits Sung-jins weakness, his family, to strike a deal with him. (金是一名警察,在偶然逮捕一名嫌疑人后参与了一场阴谋.)

programme.title: IN OUR PRIME ((普通男女))
programme.desc: Genius Mathematician defected from the North tried to hide his past eventually started teaching a student who gave up on Maths the right way to find the answer. (流派的数学家从北方试图隐藏自己的过去,最终开始教一个放弃数学的学生找到正确的答案.)

programme.title: 4PM (晚上4点)
programme.desc: A couple moved to a new house, dreaming of a peaceful country life. But they face a terrifying reality due to their neighbor, who visits them at the same time every day with just silence

programme.title: HIGHWAY FAMILY ((高速公路家族))
programme.desc: A grieving mother met a homeless young family taking shelter in highway rest areas when they asks her for money. (一位悲伤的母亲遇到了一个无家可归的年轻家庭,他们在高速公路休息区避难,)

programme.title: MAMA ((妈妈))
programme.desc: A story of Dong-sook, a mom with incurable illness and her son has fatal disease, Eun-sook, whose dreams eclipsed by her mom and Seung-chul, a gangster tries to find his moms first love. (故事讲述了东苏克,一个母亲患有不可治愈的疾病,她的儿子患有致命的疾病, 苏克,她的梦想被她的母亲和楚尔罩着,)

programme.title: PUNCH-DRUNK LOVE ((私恋失调))
programme.desc: Bok-seo gave up to be a soccer player after an injury. He meets Bok-hee and falls in love with her. Bok-hee feels unsure but she appreciates his sincerity, leading to something special... (波克因受伤而放弃了足球运动员,他遇到了波克希,爱上了她.波克希感到不确定,但她欣赏他的诚实,导致了一些特别的...)

programme.title: HI-FIVE
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: FIREFIGHTERS (消防员)
programme.desc: Based on the Hongje-dong fire accident in 2001, the movie depicts the harsh conditions that firefighters face every day as if it were their last mission to save lives and survive. (根据2001年香港东发生的火灾事故,这部电影描述了消防员每天面临的恶劣条件,)

programme.title: ACTIONHERO ((动作英雄))
programme.desc: A college student dreaming to be an action star discovered an admission fraud. He decided to make an action film of him against the corrupted professor. (一位梦想成为动作明星的大学生发现了招生欺诈行为,)

On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly ((美食新闻周报))
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50 ((中文))
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: Finance Magazine 2026 ((寻龙诀·觅踪))

Through exclusive interviews with industry professionals and market analysis, the program explores popular local and international finance topics in a clear and accessible manner. It also features in-depth reports on the challenges faced by different industries as they develop.

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong and Global View ((热带雨))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. (报道关于香港,跨海和国际事务的重要新闻.)

programme.title: Another Era ((再创世纪))
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry (2008年,随着金融混乱的海淹没世界,雄心勃勃的企业家霍廷山·库克春· (Ho Tin-Sang Kwok Chun On) 看到机会寻求接管香港最富有的人,春的武功商业帝国,但被另一位商界巨头克凯·普恩干预.他对他的仇恨,桑一直在寻求报复.十年后,现在最富有的克家族被不幸所遮蔽.凯的儿子突然去世是对凯的压倒性打击,他因心脏病发作而昏迷.为了让他们的业务继续前进,他的未经验的年轻女儿克戴,小·,与私人代理人克,克和克,克-克,克)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026 ((举起手来! 2026))
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge. (儿童节目"手上升"鼓励孩子们勇敢地问问题,表达自己,追求自己的目标!子家族成员加入主持人表演短短剧,陪伴所有人享受快乐的时刻.节目还将有各种儿童歌曲,让孩子们一起唱歌,同时学习实用生活知识.)

programme.title: Severe Case Decoded Whats On Today (严重案件解码今天的《今日何事》)
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! Stroll along Argentinas World Heritage glaciers and sample whiskey infused with glacial ice. Discover the idyllic paradise of Patagonia, enjoying its stunning scenery and delicious cuisine. Head to Easter Island in Chile, cycling around the island in search of giant stone statues. Explore the Amazon rainforest, the worlds largest tropical rainforest, with an adventure alongside the indigenous people. Visit the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador, famous for their evolutionary history, and explore their animal ecology. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders lives.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)
